hypotheses.title: Batch 69: Orthogonal Fundamental EBITDA & Quality Breakout (Targeting 4th Daily Approved Alpha)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies our battle-tested, low-turnover 3-term multi-factor architecture (which delivered Alpha 20, 21, and 22 with self-correlations of 0.59-0.63 and Fitness 1.61-1.85) to entirely unmined fundamental accounting domains: (1) Operating EBITDA Yield + Quarterly Audited FX Hedging in TOP2000 (Market Neutral): Captures pre-financing operating profitability before non-cash depreciation distortions. (2) EBIT Yield + Quarterly Audited FX Hedging in TOP1000 (Industry Neutral): Isolates enterprise operating earnings yield within large-caps. (3) Piotroski Fundamental Quality Score + Quarterly Audited FX Hedging in TOP2000 (Market Neutral): Exploits structural accounting health and balance-sheet quality from Model51. (4) 2-Year LEAP Call IV (720d) + Quarterly Audited FX Hedging in TOP2000 (Sector Neutral): Deploys intermediate 2-year institutional volatility risk premia across TOP2000.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if fundamental EBITDA or quality metrics correlate with momentum during cyclical earnings contractions.
